source.robots_observation: Public product pages are accessible; robots.txt disallows search/catalog/internal API paths, explicitly declares crawl delay 5 for ClaudeBot, and publishes sitemap indexes.

pilot_results.offer_scope_note: Only the currently selected color-size combination on each live product page received a live price/availability RetailerOffer. Other visible sizes were stored as variants without inferred stock.

sampled_products.product: Men's Regular Fit Pinpoint Dress Shirt

image_policy: Image URLs were not promoted into public ProductMaster image fields in this pilot. Image display requires rights/permission handling beyond attribution.
next_scope: Continue Macy's department-by-department only through accessible, permitted public category/product paths or an authorized product feed; do not use disallowed internal APIs.
